parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State or imply the form $\dfrac{A}{3x-1}+\dfrac{Bx+C}{x^2+3}$. B1. Use a correct method for finding a constant. M1. Obtain one of $A=1,B=0,C=3$ from correct working. A1; maximum M1 A1 after B0. Obtain a second value from correct working. A1. Obtain the third value from correct working. A1. Total 5.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Integrate to obtain $\dfrac13\ln(3x-1)$. B1 FT on $A$; OE, for example $\frac13\ln(x-\frac13)$. Obtain a term of the form $k\tan^{-1}(x/\sqrt3)$. M1. Obtain $\sqrt3\tan^{-1}(x/\sqrt3)$. A1 FT on $C$. Substitute the correct limits in $a\ln(3x-1)+k\tan^{-1}(x/\sqrt3)$, with $ak\ne0$, subtract in the correct order and evaluate the trigonometry. M1; angles must be in radians but decimal angles are condoned. Obtain $\dfrac23\ln2+\dfrac{\sqrt3\pi}{6}$, or an exact two-term equivalent such as $\frac13\ln4+\frac{\sqrt3\pi}{6}$. A1 ISW. Total 5.
